budget_items.topic: Chapter 70 share of school department funding
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Chapter 70 funding as a share of the school department was reported as declining.
budget_items.quote: ch 70 funding as a percentage of the school department has been declining - 35.9% in fy21.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY22 recommended school budget was reported as a 2.5% increase, compared with 1.58% in FY21.
budget_items.quote: fy22 recommended budget reflects 2.5% increase, up from 1.58% in fy21.

budget_items.topic: Cares Act money for full return
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A committee member asked whether Cares Act money would fund the full return; no dollar figure was given.
budget_items.quote: do you anticipate use of cares act money to facilitate full return?

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The current special purpose stabilization balance was reported, with a further amount needed to fund two large fire trucks.
budget_items.quote: current balance is $1,198,705. we'd need another $325k.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A $100K stabilization recommendation was reported as exceeding fiscal policy.
budget_items.quote: i - stabilization $100k recommendation exceeds fiscal policy

budget_items.what_was_recorded: OPEB figures were reported unchanged, to come from free cash and the sewer revolving account; no dollar figure was given.
budget_items.quote: l - opeb #'s haven't changed. will come from free cash and sewer revolving account.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Bag fees may need adjusting to make solid waste revenues exceed the current revenue figure.
budget_items.quote: solid waste, we'll need to adjust bag fees to cover cost of operations to make revenues greater than current $302k.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A Health Insurance Stabilization Fund amount was reported, based on savings for FY22.
budget_items.quote: o - health insurance stabilization fund $369,334 based on savings for fy22

budget_items.topic: Article P cemetery lot sale funds
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A $15,000 amount was reported for use of cemetery lot sale funds, in addition to the operating account.
budget_items.quote: p - $15,000 for use of sale of cemetery lots funds, in addition to operating account

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A committee member said the primary school needs approximately $300,000 in spending and that nothing is being done.
budget_items.quote: the primary school, in need of approximately $300,000 in spending and we are doing nothing.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Work on a snow and ice deficit was reported, with uncertainty whether year-end funds would cover it; no dollar figure was given.
budget_items.quote: working on snow and ice deficit and whether there will be sufficient end of year funds to cover.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The earmark for the fire alarm was confirmed to expire at the end of FY21; no dollar figure was given.
budget_items.quote: mrs. lemieux - confirmed earmark for fire alarm expires end of fy21.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The school district said there is no financial impact from the eliminated or offset positions; no dollar figure was given.
budget_items.quote: mr. cassidy - there is no financial impact. we can do involuntary transfers.
